comparison.objective: Secure a gas cylinder to a wall bracket with a chain.
comparison.physical_skill: Route, hook, and tension a chain around an upright cylinder without contacting its valve.
comparison.success_condition: Chain correctly positioned, hooked and snug; hands clear; cylinder passes a 10 N pull test without excessive tilt.
comparison.reason: Chain routing and restraint verification do not test particle flow or screening. No material rubric detail is missing.
